image_description: A close-up, angled view of a vintage audio cassette tape. The casing is primarily silver/grey with a large red and white label on the face. The label features text including 'MAGNETIC TAPE' and '120'. A blue plastic spool is visible through one of the circular windows. The top edge shows the magnetic tape strip itself. The image has a slightly grainy, retro aesthetic.
